acceptance_criteria.condition: A fresh ten-task corpus contains both cohorts and real single-module, cross-module, and integration topologies; an Agent workspace receives only one public task tree.
Hidden scoring rejects policy-only repair, blank documentation or metadata, registry retargeting, and unused-import duplicate implementations while reference repairs pass.
The frozen envelope is internally consistent and cannot be represented as a completed effect result before trials exist.
The Skill package remains valid and regression-clean after the new protocol and documentation are added.
acceptance_criteria.verification: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v

invariants: Only the condition-specific frozen Skill availability may differ across a preregistered task block.
The public Agent workspace excludes hidden tests and reference fixes; the scorer injects only hidden tests after Agent exit into a disposable copy.
Cross-module consumers and dynamic adapters must demonstrably return the canonical owner's result, not merely contain an import string.
A planned experiment with zero trials is not evidence of Skill effectiveness or general model causal ability.
Any completed conclusion is limited to the fixed native subagent model, shared-filesystem Harness, frozen snapshots, corpus, and blind hidden scorer.
replaced_paths: The uncommitted V1 source-string delegation checks that accepted unused canonical-owner imports while duplicate normalization code ran.

retained_compatibility.consumer: Each integration fixture runtime/<task-id>.json registry retains its named plugins.<task-id>_adapter module.
retained_compatibility.removal_condition: A new corpus revision explicitly retires the dynamic adapter contract and supplies a matching hidden regression.

safeguards.name: fresh deterministic corpus
safeguards.rationale: The standard-library generator creates new public, hidden, and reference trees and records their digests in the manifest.

safeguards.name: post-exit hidden scoring
safeguards.rationale: The runner copies only a public task tree to the Agent workspace and inserts scorer-only tests into a disposable candidate only after the Agent exits.

safeguards.name: runtime canonical-owner probe
safeguards.rationale: Hidden tests monkeypatch the live consumer or adapter binding and require the delegated sentinel return value.

safeguards.name: positive documentation and metadata contract
safeguards.rationale: Hidden tests require the current canonical marker in each prose surface and the exact metadata value, rather than merely checking old-marker absence.

safeguards.name: fixed complete-block analysis
safeguards.rationale: The envelope requires every task's three preregistered conditions and forbids early stopping or selective retry.

design_boundary.rationale: The generator owns fixtures and hidden contract creation; the runner owns public-workspace preparation and scoring; the analyzer owns the statistical decision.

dependency_audit.rationale: No dependency, lockfile, or external service was added; the protocol uses the Python standard library and the native Codex subagent surface.

extension_decision.rationale: The protocol adds no application extension point or public adapter interface.

data_ownership.rationale: Public task inputs, private hidden/reference trees, candidate workspaces, and evidence artifacts have separate explicit lifecycles.

error_model.rationale: Scope violation, public failure, hidden failure, timeout, and interrupted trial remain separately recordable outcomes rather than being silently retried.

contract_evolution.rationale: Native V1 is a new frozen envelope; historical API-key and older interrupted protocols remain unchanged.

operational_budget.rationale: The preregistration freezes a 300-second Agent timeout, a 20-second test timeout, and a no-early-stop rule.

threat_boundary.rationale: Hidden tests, references, prior outputs, and condition outcomes are outside the declared Agent input; native filesystem sharing remains a documented protocol-isolation limit.

delivery_lifecycle.rationale: Generator, runner, tests, manifest, frozen snapshots, README, review, and evidence are committed as one verified preparation scope before collection.

release_recovery.rationale: This is an offline evaluation protocol with no production release or user rollout.

data_migration.rationale: No application schema, production record, or data migration changes.

configuration_secrets.rationale: The native route does not consume or record API keys, credentials, or runtime secret configuration.

dependency_supply_chain.rationale: No package manifest, lockfile, or dependency version changed.

operational_knowledge.rationale: README identifies the native protocol, its purpose, and its protocol-isolation limitation; the review records every corrected scoring defect.

reproducibility.rationale: The envelope hashes the manifest, generator, runner, prompt, old/new snapshots, task order, and analysis threshold before collection.

verification.result: 8 focused protocol, topology, positive-documentation, post-exit-scoring, scope, registry, and runtime-delegation adversarial tests passed.
The analyzer accepted the frozen envelope and returned planned/not_run with causal conclusion unknown.

verification.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v

Analyzer acceptance of planned envelope without model outcomes.

supporting_artifacts.summary: Independent review that found, reproduced, and approved repairs for five protocol loopholes.
Frozen planned three-condition native experiment envelope with no trial data.
Hash-linked manifest for ten topology-varying tasks and their public, hidden, and reference tree digests.

rollback_or_compatibility: Revert the generator, runner, tests, manifest, frozen envelope, README entry, and this evidence together if a stronger independently verified execution mechanism replaces Native V1. Do not alter this envelope after trial collection starts.

independent_review.notes: The reviewer identified five concrete bypasses before trial collection, verified the repairs, and confirmed reference fixtures still pass while unused-import duplicate implementations fail.

remaining_risks: No trial has run, so no Skill-effect, repair-success, or causal-capability improvement is established by this preparation commit.
Native subagents share a filesystem; the protocol is not a security sandbox and cannot prevent a deliberately noncompliant Agent from searching external paths.
The synthetic corpus is small and targeted, so even a completed passing analysis would not generalize to all repositories, failure modes, or model configurations.
The configured remote API-key route remains unavailable and is intentionally not cited as effect evidence.
